excluded: RFC5227 ACD/gratuitous/proxy/security and pending IP-packet queue

ARP-826.interpretation: Request/reply fields in network order; merge existing sender entry before target-address test, learn new sender only for local target, reply to targeted request.

ARP-CACHE.interpretation: Remove stale entries, prevent ARP request floods. Configurable cache TTL and1000ms one-retry policy are finite model choices.

ARP-PROFILE.interpretation: Explicit one-peer cache and Ethernet field/domain/short-entry/padding/service policies; not full ARP or host conformance.
